title: Cardioprotective effect of phytosterol stigmasterol supplementation against doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity.
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物甾醇豆甾醇对阿霉素诱导心脏毒性的保护作用，仅涉及小分子与NF-κB的对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Stigmasterol, a phytosterol abundantly found in various plant sources, including soybeans and other legumes, plays a significant pharmaceutical role due to its pharmacological properties. Research suggests that stigmasterol exhibits anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cholesterol-lowering effects, making it a promising candidate for managing cardiovascular disorders. In this work, we elucidated the cardioprotective potency of stigmasterol against doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity in rats. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Hence we have evaluated the potency of stigmasterol supplementation in preventing doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity. Male Wistar rats were treated with doxorubicin (2.5 mg/kg) and supplemented with 25 and 50 mg/kg doses of stigmasterol for 14 days. On day 14 of treatment tail-cuff plethysmography was conducted to assess the hemodynamic parameters. The concentrations of oxidative stress markers, cardiac function markers, myocardial damage markers, and inflammatory biomarkers were assessed in the experimental rats using the commercial kits. The heart tissues were subjected to the histopathological analysis. Docking study was also conducted with NF-kappaB. RESULTS: The stigmasterol treatment effectively increased the body weight and heart weight and elevated the hemodynamic parameters in doxorubinin-induced rats. The stigmasterol treatment also decreased the oxidative stress via increasing antioxidants, reduced the cardiac function markers, and decreased the myocardial damage markers in the doxorubicin-induced rats. Furthermore, the stigmasterol treatment also reduced the inflammatory markers in the doxorubicin-induced rats. The cardioprotective properties of the stigmasterol was further supported by the results of histopathological analysis and docking analysis where it showed excellent binding affinity for NF-kappaB. CONCLUSIONS: The results of tail-cuff plethysmography and cardiac tissue histopathological analysis authentically proved the inhibitory effect of stigmasterol against doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity. To conclude supplementation with phytochemical stigmasterol persuasively ameliorated doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity.
abstract_zh: 背景：豆甾醇（stigmasterol）是一种在多种植物来源（包括大豆及其他豆类）中含量丰富的植物甾醇，因其药理特性而具有重要的药学作用。研究表明，豆甾醇具有抗炎、抗氧化和降胆固醇作用，使其成为管理心血管疾病的潜在候选药物。在本研究中，我们阐明了豆甾醇对大鼠多柔比星（doxorubicin）诱导的心脏毒性的心脏保护效力。材料与方法：因此，我们评估了豆甾醇补充剂在预防多柔比星诱导的心脏毒性方面的效力。雄性Wistar大鼠接受多柔比星（2.5 mg/kg）处理，并补充25和50 mg/kg剂量的豆甾醇，持续14天。在治疗第14天，采用尾袖法（tail-cuff plethysmography）评估血流动力学参数。使用商业试剂盒测定实验大鼠中氧化应激标志物、心脏功能标志物、心肌损伤标志物和炎症生物标志物的浓度。心脏组织进行组织病理学分析。同时进行了与NF-kappaB的对接研究。结果：豆甾醇治疗有效增加了多柔比星诱导大鼠的体重和心脏重量，并提高了血流动力学参数。豆甾醇治疗还通过增加抗氧化剂降低了氧化应激，减少了心脏功能标志物，并降低了多柔比星诱导大鼠的心肌损伤标志物。此外，豆甾醇治疗还降低了多柔比星诱导大鼠的炎症标志物。豆甾醇的心脏保护特性进一步得到组织病理学分析和对接分析结果的支持，其中它显示出对NF-kappaB的优异结合亲和力。结论：尾袖法测压和心脏组织组织病理学分析的结果真实地证明了豆甾醇对多柔比星诱导的心脏毒性的抑制作用。总之，补充植物化学物质豆甾醇显著改善了多柔比星诱导的心脏毒性。
